matrix_name: Journey to the West Villain Evaluation Matrix
design_purpose: Plots every monster in the book precisely onto a motivation × resources matrix, revealing the underlying law that affiliation decides fate: monsters with backing all return to their posts, while rootless nobodies are all killed or flee.

x_axis.name: Source of motivation
x_axis.description: 从'纯粹求生'(0) 到'形而上的怨念'(10)

scale_labels.5-6: 报复与上位（取代取经团队）
scale_labels.7-8: 执念追求（成为某人/某物）

y_axis.name: Resource abundance
y_axis.description: 从'草根单干'(0) 到'拥有跨三界背景'(10)

scale_labels.0-2: 草根单干（无法宝无小妖）
scale_labels.3-4: 占山为王（有小妖无法宝）

quadrants.label: Strong backing + metaphysical
quadrants.description: Top-tier backing + metaphysical motive — a rare top-tier villain, the only one in the book.
quadrants.typical_outcome: Taken in personally by senior Buddhist figures
quadrants.name: Top-left

quadrants.label: Strong backing + survival
quadrants.description: Heavenly/Buddhist establishment + mission-driven — a mountain-warlord type shielded by affiliation.
quadrants.typical_outcome: Reclaimed by their patron and restored to their post
quadrants.name: Top-right

quadrants.label: Weak backing + survival
quadrants.description: Rootless lone operator + instinctive survival — the classic cannon fodder, 40% of the book.
quadrants.name: Bottom-left

quadrants.label: Weak backing + metaphysical
quadrants.description: Rootless origin + metaphysical motive — an inner-demon villain, the only one in the book.
quadrants.name: Bottom-right

matrix_insights: Bottom-left holds 40% · all killed or driven to flee — the fate of rootless cannon fodder
Top-right holds 47% · all reclaimed by their patrons — the affiliation-as-amulet effect
Top-left has just 1 case (Great Peng, the Golden-Winged Roc) · taken in by senior Buddhists — the submission logic of a top-tier villain
Bottom-right has just 1 case (Six-Eared Macaque) · the lone example of an inner-demon villain
Affiliation decides fate — this is the underlying law of the book's villain evaluation
